entries.title: A card's thread sits on its back on your iPhone, and under its own reply box on your Mac
entries.body: On your iPhone and iPad, a card's conversation no longer runs under its body. One line at the card's foot says who wrote last, how many messages there are, or 1 new when a reply came in; tap it, or press Command-backslash, and the card turns over to show the thread, its reply box and its choices. Card turns it back. On your Mac, while a card's thread is open beside it, the card's choices sit under the thread's reply box, so it is clear that what you typed goes with the choice you click.

picture.alt: A card with its thread open beside it, and the card's choices under the thread's reply box
